author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design project collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual design, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, one advertising flag, other exhibition derivatives (hanging scrolls, panels), and pre-press size checks. Timeline: early October first draft of main visual and logotype; mid-October final; early November all output files; mid-November to print; early December exhibition. Seeking someone with exhibition/graphic design experience and a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio and quote. Contact via Threads comments or DM.
